calls.title: Product Analytics AI Analyst Bug Bash
calls.summary: The team met to discuss enhancing AI model flexibility by allowing per-chat model selection alongside organizational defaults. Features like a feedback mechanism with a thumbs-up/down system and optional freeform input were also proposed to capture user sentiment effectively. Client-side search functionality for conversation titles and first messages was confirmed to improve efficiency, with pagination planned for better performance. An evaluation framework was established to validate AI outputs through unit-test style validations, while plans for launching the Explore feature in beta with user feedback integrations were discussed. Finally, clear responsibilities were assigned to team members, ensuring alignment on design and development tasks.
calls.keywords: AI model selection, feedback mechanism, client-side search, AI eval tests, telemetry tracking, data source selector
